metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Helixir Labs. Agent-native productivity tools.

plugins.name: personal-knowledge-assistant
plugins.description: Agent-native PKM: notes/files separation (per-domain Obsidian vaults + plain-PARA file workspaces), capture inboxes, ADHD-friendly top-3 planning, inbox triage with naming/tags/Spotlight, daily/weekly reviews, session logging. 7 skills, 2 agents, hooks. Reads the ~/pka contract repo.

plugins.name: helixir-ralph-workflow
plugins.description: Coordinated ralph workflow integrating flow-next task management with gstack quality gates. Patches default ralph templates for receipt-gated quality checks, two-pass task validation, and design review integration.

plugins.name: brilliant-gstack-connector
plugins.description: Bridges GStack design output (and arbitrary HTML / descriptions) into Brilliant via the Brilliant MCP. The /design-brilliant skill ports a finalized HTML file, a free-form description, or an auto-detected GStack finalized.html onto a live Brilliant canvas, exports a PNG preview, and appends a dated changelog entry under design/Reviews/. Requires the Brilliant desktop app and a design/ folder Brilliant has opened.
